sentences.en: Let me congratulate you on your victory in the tournament.
sentences.zh: 让我祝贺你在锦标赛中的胜利。

sentences.en: People buy these tickets many months before the tournament starts.
sentences.zh: 人们在锦标赛开始前几个月就购买这些票。

sentences.en: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
sentences.zh: 他在国际象棋锦标赛中获得了第一名。

senses.zh: 锦标赛，联赛,中世纪的骑士比武,锦标赛
